data.name: Aaeesha
data.gender_notes: Aaeesha is used as a female name.
data.long_meaning: Aaeesha (عائشة) is a transliteration variant of ʿĀ'ishah, the feminine participle of the Arabic verb ʿāsha, 'to live', so it means 'living, alive, prosperous'. It is the name of ʿĀ'ishah, a wife of the Prophet Muhammad and a major narrator of hadith.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name carries the sense of a living, thriving person; any further spiritual reading is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Feminine participle of Arabic ʿāsha, 'to live'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaeesha total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aaeesha mean?
faq.a: Aaeesha means Living; alive; prosperous (variant of ʿĀ'ishah).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aaeesha?
What language does the name Aaeesha come from?
faq.a: Aaeesha is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aaeesha a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaeesha is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aaeesha written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aaeesha is written عائشة in Arabic and عائشہ in Urdu, and आइशा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aaeesha?
faq.a: The root of Aaeesha is ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aaeesha?
faq.a: Feminine participle of Arabic ʿāsha, 'to live'.

faq.q: Does Aaeesha appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not itself a Qur'anic name; from the root ʿ-y-sh, 'to live'.
ʿĀ'ishah was a wife of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the most important narrators of hadith; she is a central figure in early Islamic history.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aaeesha?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaeesha total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aaeesha?
faq.a: Aaeesha appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aaisha, Aisha, Ayesha.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aaeesha?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aaeesha include Aaisha, Aaishaht.

faq.q: Is Aaeesha the same as Aaisha?
faq.a: Yes. Aaeesha and Aaisha are transliterations of the same Arabic ʿĀ'ishah (عائشة), meaning 'living, alive'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aaeesha used today?
faq.a: Aaeesha is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
